address: Taberna do São Paulo, Rua de S. Paulo 196, 1200-109 Lisboa

reviews.author: Sandhya Chhetri
reviews.text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Excellent experience! The food was incredibly delicious and fresh, the atmosphere was warm and enjoyable, and the service was fast, friendly, and professional. The authentic Portuguese dishes were especially memorable and full of flavor. The quality of both the food and hospitality was outstanding. I will definitely come back and highly recommend this place to others!

reviews.author: Akriti Yadav
reviews.text: Very nice restaurant, lovely dishes. Had the seafood rice and it was great. Also ate the vegetable rice it was really good. Service was amazing, didn’t have to wait long. Would recommend making a reservation as it gets quite busy.

reviews.author: Gabriella Arcari
reviews.text: Lovely service from Sandi and the other guy working out the front! Great location and food is 10/10. Highly recommend. Highly recommend dishes in images attached. Huge portions!

reviews.author: ava
reviews.text: The food was delicious and authentic, and everything we ordered was very well prepared. The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the atmosphere was warm and relaxed. We had a wonderful dinner here and really enjoyed the experience. Definitely a place I would recommend in Lisbon!

reviews.author: Shlesha Poudel
reviews.text: Great service! Great food and amazing atmosphere. Sat outside with a few drinks and great appetizers!

reviews.author: Tomekk Ch

A very pleasant place with friendly service. The breakfasts are varied and delicious. We walked in off the street and highly recommend it.

PS

reviews.author: Theodore Lim
reviews.text:
Very friendly staff made my breakfast a more personal experience. Went back 2 days in a row and they remembered me and we chatted more.
The waffles and the morning special were quite yummy, and reasonably priced!

reviews.author: Ella Schauble
reviews.text: Would come here everyday if I could. Firstly the staff are just incredible and so kind. The food was just absolutely delicious, I had the best iced mocha here. Waffles were absolutely delicious as well. Very peaceful atmosphere, felt really welcoming. Absolute must eat here if you can.

reviews.author: Sotiris Apostolou (Salvador)
reviews.text:
An absolute gem of a specialty coffee shop in Lisbon! The moment you walk into Daily Dose, you are greeted by an incredibly unique and whimsical atmosphere. The design is spectacular featuring a stunning unicorn and fantasy castle mural, cozy pastel pink velvet scallop chairs, and beautiful greenery trailing along the ceiling. They've also added playful designer toy figures to the marble-top tables, which makes the vibe feel very chic and modern.
​The coffee itself is flawless. I had an espresso and a latte; the espresso was rich and beautifully pulled with a perfect crema, and the latte art was executed to perfection. It’s clear they take their specialty coffee very seriously here. Combined with the friendly service and the lovely natural light streaming in through the large street front windows, it's the perfect spot to relax or catch up with a friend. Definitely a new favorite in the city!

reviews.author: Leia Eloise Dow
reviews.text: So pretty!! I love the decor and the staff were so kind and accommodating! The iced Ube latte with espresso is delicious, and I can't wait to come back and try more!

reviews.text: Great food and drinks, excellent price (happy hour goes til 10pm) and the best service! Miguel was so amazing we came back for a second night and might even end our trip there tonight. He was super thoughtful, nice and fun! Had the best time there ❤️

reviews.text: Very nice place and the food was soo soo delicious.LV and Fahad both are great bartenders. Recommend 💯%

reviews.author: Marissa Persico

reviews.author: Biagio Ziccardi

address: Santa Marta, R. de Santa Marta 61, 1150-294 Lisboa

reviews.author: Edmond Neo
reviews.text:
It’s a little gem in the heart of Lisbon, snugged in a quiet enclave away from the busyness of Lisbon city.
We had the grilled chicken with peri peri sauce. The chicken was so tender and tasty with a crispy grilled skin which adds a nice crunch - definitely not to be missed. The roast duck with pistachio topping and risotto was also divine. The tiramisu is a MUST HAVE. One of the best. And with all that liquor and just the right amount of sweetness. Cool dining vibes and clean clean toilets! Excellent service from Rafael too.

reviews.author: David Goggin
reviews.text: This place was a score. Burrata appetizer was very good. The Spaghetti ala Chitarra was Delicious!! The Guanciale pizza was amazing!!! So good. Kevin L was our Server and he was exceptional.  Great attitude.  This is a must try.  We may have to come back before we head home.

reviews.author: Rhys Burmann
reviews.text: I'm not one to throw out five stars just because. And I've been critical of this place in the past, as you might see from my reviews. But this time and last night when I came for dinner I was impressed. I felt previously that they had overlooked customer service a tiny bit. The food was always great but the service was slightly lacking. I think they've up to their game a little bit and they are killing it. The attention to detail the friendliness the going above and beyond is noticeable. And honestly I think having been in the restaurant industry for many years I can tell when it's just hype or what it's just an act. But I ran into some very impressive servers. And of course the food was excellent. And I even learned a few things from the chef who came out to speak to me about his gelato. Well done Santa Marta well done.

reviews.author: MaX
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic dining experience at Santa Marta! The food was absolutely delicious, especially the pasta, which was perfectly prepared and full of flavour. The dessert was simply incredible and the perfect way to end an amazing meal!

A special thank you to Luis, who provided outstanding service! He was incredibly friendly, attentive and welcoming, making our evening even more enjoyable.

Everything was perfect, from the delicious food to the wonderful atmosphere and excellent service. Definitely one of the highlights of our trip to Portugal!

reviews.author: 맛도리맨
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, we experienced discriminatory behavior from a staff member named MARIANA during our honeymoon.

​However, the food was exceptional—especially the seafood, pasta, and guanciale pizza. I’m truly grateful to the waiter with glasses who sincerely apologized on her behalf, and the friendly Chinese trainee who recommended the great pizza.

​I deducted 1 star SOLELY because of Mariana, but I’d love to visit again for the amazing food and the rest of the wonderful staff 😀.

reviews.author: Henry Clarkin
reviews.text:
Fantastic cocktail bar nestled inside a very beautiful hotel.

The bartenders are very knowledgeable and accommodating.

Great wine selection too!

reviews.author: Michael Peggs
reviews.text: Leonor is a true artist. She took the time to walk us through the cocktail menu and each drink was better than the last. My finance and I had 4 drinks and we were impressed by her mixology acumen, hospitality and warmth as she welcomed us to Lisbon. This bar should be 10x busier than it was, it deserves nothing short of 10’s across the board.

reviews.author: Govind Dhar
reviews.text: Smart space perfect for more romantic evenings, or for individuals looking for a very friendly and chatty mixologist, Verse is very date-centric but they whipped up a few cocktails for us with bourbon and passionfruit, gin and citrus in between.

reviews.author: Natasha Foylan
reviews.text:
A relatively small spot hidden in what looks like the lobby of a hotel. We stumbled across it by accident but were drawn in by the mood lighting and overall vibe. The barman was incredibly nice and offered us a cocktail menu with special cocktails created by him. The cocktails were a Portuguese twist on the classics us cocktail lovers all know and love. I had a "Neruda" which was a smokier Margarita that had a special smokey volcanic salt from the Portuguese islands. A "the Boss" and which screamed Negroni but with Port wine instead of the classic ingredients. As well as a Bento mule, which we all agreed was a much better version of the Moscow Mule.

Definitely worth the price. Really great experience!

reviews.author: Gareth
reviews.text:
Stumbled across this hotel cocktail bar completely by chance and had a few drinks before a dinner reservation. A wonderful hidden gem.

The bartender was so gracious and welcoming and made us feel very welcome (I didn't catch her name but she is an asset to the bar!) - we had an incredible wine called 'Dry to the Bone' as well as two excellent cocktails. We would've stayed longer but had to get to dinner!

title: The Verse Cocktail Bar

address: Pitada Kitchen, R. Gomes Freire 185A, 1150-178 Lisboa

reviews.author: Kristy Snow
reviews.text:
We had such a lovely experience at Pitada Kitchen. We all ordered the Maminha Grelhada (grilled maminha/tri-tip) for €14, which came with salad and a choice of rice or fries. The meat was flavourful and really enjoyable.

I asked for a couple of small changes to my meal, swapping the usual accompaniment for potatoes and an egg instead of the salad, and they were completely accommodating, with no fuss at all. It was really appreciated.

And the pastel de nata pie was so good! Definitely worth saving room for.

We sat outside on the street, which gave the restaurant a really lovely, relaxed Lisbon atmosphere. There were lots of authentic Portuguese options on the menu and the prices were very fair.

But what really made our evening was the owner. He was so friendly and attentive, coming by our table several times to make sure everything was okay and that we were enjoying our food. His warmth and hospitality genuinely made our night.

It’s one of those places where the food is good, the prices are reasonable, but the people are what make the experience memorable. We really enjoyed our evening here and would happily return.

reviews.author: Alik K

Very tasty and fresh foods.
Friendly and helpful staff.

address: The Coffee Cais do Sodré, Rua de S. Paulo 81, 1200-058 Lisboa

reviews.author: Nicholas Stevenson
reviews.text:
During my trip to Lisbon I tried a variety of coffee shops, but this was one I stopped by more than once. Sure, it was close to my lodging and to the bustling streets of Lisbon, but it was also tasty

Walking through the gorgeous city blocks in the heart of Lisbon we just happened upon this spot. I was drawn because it was a fairly simple yet appealing storefront. The signage reminded me of the font used for the show “the office.”

You can order at the street window or go inside. There are a couple areas to sit inside, but it’s a very small cafe. I took my order to go on both occasions

There are baristas who make the coffee in the small visible kitchen area. Everything was clean and orderly. You can view the menu (digital options at both order areas), and you order on a kiosk

There are so many classic and signature drinks you can choose from. There are iced drinks, hot drinks, drip coffee, matcha drinks, gelato coffees, etc. there’s also sandwiches, sweets, and other bakery items

The staff were fairly efficient and professional. They weren’t particularly friendly, but they make good coffee.

Everything tasted great, and it’s definitely worth a stop

Some tips:
This is one of the many coffee shops I stumbled upon that has options for the frappe or other espresso based drinks to be sweetened with gelato. I’m a huge affogato fan, so, this was intriguing

Online you can find their menu, locations, and other information. You can purchase coffee beans/grounds. You can also see their collabs, how they roast their beans in Brazil, and that this chain actually got started in Japan. There’s also hundreds of locations all over the world with slightly different menus

I don’t believe they have teas. I mean, it sort of makes sense with the name, but at the same time I think it’s worth noting

I’m a huge flat white fan, and I’m not sure I’ve ever had flavored flat whites. They have a flat caramel here, and I love caramel, so, I gave it a try, and it was delicious. Not especially sweet, but an almost subtle caramel flavoring to what already is a near perfect drink

Cheers!!

reviews.author: Sadia Raboud
reviews.text:
The Coffee is my fav in Lisbon!!! The quality of their coffee is next level ! And honestly whatever you try is GOLD

I personally love their true white , vanilla latte , peanut butter latte …

But there is no way you get something you don’t prefer !

And the people working there are always in a good mood which makes the moment even more magical !

reviews.author: Eszter Kovács
reviews.text: Great coffee shop with some really interesting and creative coffee variations! The place is quite small, but that adds to its charm. We also tried a couple of the pastries, and they were delicious. Fun spot and definitely worth a visit!

reviews.author: M. K
reviews.text: Francisco was such a lovely barista! The drinks were absolutely delicious and beautifully made. He bought the amazing vibes to the coffee shop. Would 100% recommend :)

reviews.author: Footprints
reviews.text: This charming little cafe serves excellent coffee and matcha in a variety of flavors. You can sit and enjoy your drinks here or take them to go.

reviews.author: Dedra Berg
reviews.text:
What a wonderful evening and dinner. We had the Jade pizza and Caesar salad with chicken. Both were fantastic! The pizza was probably one of the best I have ever had. Tiramisu was also devine.

Delightfully surprised by everything!  Our server - Mathilde was awesome!  I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: B C
reviews.text:
TLDR - The best part of the meal was the portion size. The taste of each dish was quite average. If I had the ability to provide a more granular rating, I would give it 3.5 stars.

Beef tartare was nothing special. The highlight was the cured egg yolk on top of the tartare that helped to bring out the flavour of the beef, but otherwise, the dish was quite average.

We also ordered the Joana for our pizza. The ingredients felt incredibly watery and as a result, the crust couldn't hold it all properly. We had to fold up our pizza and to keep all the ingredients from dripping down our arm. Taste-wise, again it was quite ordinary, but the messiness of the pizza made it difficult to eat.

Make sure that you get a reservation. Even though we had one, we still had to wait a bit in the line outside.

reviews.author: Abby Barclay
reviews.text: Amazing food, service was really quick. We arrived to a fully booked restaurant and they made sure we were comfortable and had ordered before we got a table. Saju was a very lovely waitress. All of the staff were fantastic.

reviews.author: A Running
reviews.text: A lovely spot for a relaxed meal. We shared the arancini to start, followed by a pepperoni pizza that was excellent, flavorful with a great crust. To drink, I had the Madame signature mocktail, good but a bit too sweet for my taste. If you have a sweet tooth, this one is for you. My partner enjoyed a beer. A pleasant atmosphere and solid food, a nice choice for a casual dinner.

reviews.author: Kevin Mah
reviews.text:
Arrived at open without reservation. Party of 5 sat without delay.

All food was high quality. Pasta serving was on the small size but everything tasted good. Fried goat cheese on salad was note worthy.
